title: Patient Care Desk Reference Card: Auto Refill & Medication Sync Cycle Confirmation Settings
content:
Six confirmation settings govern each Auto Refill & Medication Sync program: whether each cycle must be confirmed, whether cycles for patients whose primary coverage is a Medicare class must be confirmed before shipping, how long the patient has to confirm, what follows when a required confirmation does not arrive, and who and by what channel may confirm.

| Program | Patient must confirm each cycle before it is filled | Cycle must be confirmed before it ships where primary coverage is a Medicare class | Hours after the confirmation request within which to confirm | When a required confirmation does not arrive | Caregiver on the profile may confirm | Confirmation by text reply |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Auto Refill 30-Day | No | No | 0 | fill anyway | Yes | Yes |
| Kestrel Auto Refill 90-Day | No | No | 0 | fill anyway | Yes | Yes |
| Kestrel Med Sync Monthly | Yes | Yes | 72 | hold the cycle | Yes | Yes |
| Kestrel Med Sync 90-Day | Yes | Yes | 72 | hold the cycle | Yes | Yes |
| Kestrel Med Sync with Adherence Packaging | Yes | Yes | 72 | hold the cycle | Yes | No |
| Kestrel Home Delivery Auto Refill | No | Yes | 72 | hold the cycle | Yes | Yes |

## Settings in words

- The confirmation window is a whole number of hours counted from the confirmation request.
- The action on a missing confirmation takes one of two values: fill anyway, or hold the cycle.
- The remaining four settings are yes-or-no switches.

## Per program

- **Kestrel Auto Refill 30-Day and Kestrel Auto Refill 90-Day**: no confirmation of each cycle, no Medicare shipment confirmation, a window of 0 hours, fill anyway; caregivers and text replies allowed.
- **Kestrel Med Sync Monthly and Kestrel Med Sync 90-Day**: every cycle confirmed, Medicare shipment confirmation on, a 72-hour window, hold the cycle; caregivers and text replies allowed.
- **Kestrel Med Sync with Adherence Packaging**: as the two Med Sync programs above, except that confirmation by text reply is not allowed.
- **Kestrel Home Delivery Auto Refill**: no confirmation of each cycle, but Medicare shipment confirmation on; a 72-hour window and hold the cycle; caregivers and text replies allowed.
